title: DEC-240 follow-ups for opum-marketplace CI hardening (review findings, not built)

description:
1. LOW, read-quest-version.sh:58/:69. "The script counts declaring LINES, not occurrences ... the greedy `.*` in the sed returns the LAST version silently."
2. LOW, workflow-hardening.test.mjs:83. "The check `/--ignore-scripts\b/` also accepts `--ignore-scripts=false`."
3. LOW, workflow-hardening.test.mjs:57. "The npm pattern misses a flag placed before the subcommand (`npm -g install`), and it does not cover `npm rebuild` or `install-test`."
4. LOW, workflow-hardening.test.mjs:26. "A step only starts at `- name|uses|run|id|if|env|with`. A step that begins with `- shell:`, `- working-directory:` or `- timeout-minutes:` is skipped entirely ..."
6. INFO, assert-no-persisted-credential.sh:23/:34. "`git config --local` does not follow include or includeIf unless `--includes` is passed."
7. INFO ... "a `$(printf | tr)` inside an echo argument" (failing path only).
8. INFO, assert-main-fast-forward.test.sh ... "comments at :297-308 and the mutation table at :45-49 still describe the fetch refspec ... the no-token grep at :415 checks only `DEV_FETCH_TOKEN` and `secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN`."
9. INFO, ci.yml:179 and :218. "The manifest job `git fetch origin \"$BASE_REF\"` calls ... are also redundant under that job `fetch-depth: 0`."
10. INFO, read-quest-version.sh:50. "If the markers are on adjacent lines ... fails with \"no Quest CLI line\" instead of \"block is empty\"."

DISPOSITION 2026-10-28 (branch chore/OMARK-102-ci-review-followups). FIXED, each with a both-ways proof run locally: (1) read-quest-version.sh now counts grep -o occurrences, so two declarations on one line exit 1 by name; pre-fix script run against the new fixture printed a version and exited 0. (10) adjacent markers are named as an empty block; pre-fix reported no Quest CLI line. (6) assert-no-persisted-credential.sh passes --includes on both config reads; fixture holds the extraheader only in an include.path file; pre-fix exited 0 on it. (2) hasIgnoreScripts rejects =false and --no-ignore-scripts; mutant restoring the old test dies on exactly the =false case (the --no-ignore-scripts fixture was already rejected by the old regex, so it is extra coverage not proof). (3) NPM_CMD finds the subcommand after leading flags and covers rebuild, install-test, it, cit; mutant restoring the old pattern dies on exactly npm -g install and npm rebuild (install-test was already caught by the old pattern through a word boundary, so that fixture is not discriminating). (4) step-start regex adds shell, working-directory, timeout-minutes, continue-on-error; mutant restoring the old list dies on exactly the three step-start fixtures. Compliant counterparts (npm -g install with the flag, =true, rebuild with the flag, npm --version) are accepted. (8) the two stale comment blocks are marked historical, and the no-token grep now matches any secrets. reference, github.token, or a TOKEN-named key; a scratch copy of the workflow with a renamed secret fails the new predicate and slips past the old grep. The comment edits in (8) are prose and have no behavioural proof. DECLINED with reasons: (7) the relayed text is a fragment of a reviewer remark about the failing path only, the reviewer record rv327-mkt231b was not available to confirm what change is meant, and the failing path prints key names and never values, so there is no demonstrated defect to fix; reopen if the full review text names one. (9) the two git fetch origin BASE_REF calls in ci.yml are redundant under fetch-depth 0 but harmless; removing them changes CI behaviour that cannot be proven both ways locally, only by a pull-request run, and the leader floor limits this task to the named edits, so the saving is not worth an unprovable workflow change. NOT checked: no run of CI itself yet; suites run locally under bash 5.3.20 and git 2.56.0.
